app.no_token: Open Biblio from the app (or run the command below): this page needs the access token.
app.update_help: Download the new version, then replace the application (your library is kept)

ask.placeholder: Ask your question, in English or French (or in PubMed syntax)…
ask.no_answer: No sentence from the sources directly answers the question.
ask.extracted: Sentences taken from the sources' abstracts, without AI: always check the article.
ask.extracted_library: Passages taken from your library (abstracts, notes, full texts).
ask.off_topic_help: Results containing fewer than half of the question's keywords
ask.continue_help: Copies a prompt to paste into Claude Desktop (Biblio extension installed): it carries the question and these sources

recommended.label: Recommended journal
recommended.help: Journal on the CDD / CNU health list (Sorbonne University)

withdrawn.label: Removed from list
withdrawn.help: Journal removed from the recommended list

not_listed.label: Not listed
not_listed.help: Journal not on the recommended list

unidentified.label: Unknown journal
unidentified.help: Journal not found (no ISSN or NLMID)

library.name: Name…
library.confirm_delete_label: Delete “{name}”? The articles stay in the library.
library.search: Search the library (full text and meaning)…
library.empty: No articles here. Add sources from the Ask screen or drop PDFs.
library.pick: Pick an article from the list.
library.drop_hint: Drop PDFs or .bib, .ris, .nbib files anywhere to import them. Drag an article onto a collection to file it.

detail.no_pdf: No PDF for this article yet.
detail.pdf_none: No free PDF found. Download it from the publisher page, then drop it here.
detail.drop_pdf: Or drop the PDF on the window.
detail.note_placeholder: Your notes in Markdown. [[key]] links to another article.

pdf.needs_metadata: {name} stored, but the article was not recognized

settings.sources_help: This stays on your computer. The email and keys are only sent to the matching databases, for better service.
settings.email_help: Requested by Crossref, OpenAlex and NCBI; required for Unpaywall.
settings.openalex_api_key_help: Free: without a key, a small shared daily budget.
settings.semanticscholar_api_key_help: Free on request: without a key, the database often refuses.
settings.watch_downloads_help: Downloaded article PDFs are imported; files are never moved or deleted.
settings.inbox_help: Any PDF dropped in {path} is imported too.
settings.semantic_help: A multilingual model (bge-m3) runs on your computer: a question in French finds passages in English. No text is sent.
settings.restart: Takes effect the next time Biblio starts.
settings.journals_help: CDD / CNU health list from Sorbonne University, checked every week.
settings.journals_same: The list is up to date
settings.style_help: c key, record citation and Markdown exports.
settings.library_bib: The whole library is kept up to date as BibTeX in {path} (LaTeX, Pandoc, Obsidian).
settings.zotero_help: Zotero must be open; articles go into the collection selected in Zotero.

package.search_help: The question, answer and sources, plus the articles already in the library with their PDFs and notes
package.rules: An article already present is completed, never duplicated. A note different from yours is appended. Your reading status and stars do not change.
package.imported: Package imported: {created} added, {completed} completed, {pdfs} PDFs, {notes} notes

watch.followed: Search followed: new articles will show in Watch
watch.retracted_help: Retracted article (published notice; Crossref and Retraction Watch data)
watch.no_alerts: No alerts. The library is checked weekly (retractions, corrections, published preprints), and followed searches at their frequency.
watch.no_searches: No saved searches. Save a search from the Ask screen, then choose its frequency here.

ai.flagged: {n} sentence(s) underlined: nothing similar in the cited sources
ai.all_checked: Every sentence was found in the cited sources

check.weak: The cited sources say nothing similar
check.invalid: Cites a source that does not exist

ai.title: Artificial intelligence
ai.help: Optional. It writes the PubMed query (in English, with MeSH), writes a cited answer from the sources found, and summarizes articles. With Ollama the model runs on your computer: nothing is sent.
ai.key_help: Stored in the macOS keychain, never in a file.
ai.ollama_hint: Ollama does not answer: open the Ollama app (Applications folder).

connectors.claude_help: Claude Desktop or Claude Code use Biblio as a tool: search with the recommended-journals filter, library, PDFs, and syntheses saved here (Question → saved searches, origin “claude”). Included in your plan, within its limits.
connectors.desktop_help: Download, then double-click biblio.mcpb: Claude Desktop offers to install it. Biblio must be open when Claude uses it.
connectors.skill_help: The method to follow (MeSH query, recommended journals, citations, saving). In Claude: Settings → Capabilities → Skills → upload the .zip.
connectors.other_help: LM Studio, Cursor, Le Chat, VS Code… Biblio's MCP server is standard: same tools and rules for all.
connectors.http_help: For clients that connect to an address: first run “{command}”.
connectors.token_warning: The HTTP configuration contains Biblio's token: do not share it.
connectors.webhooks_help: Biblio sends a JSON POST on each chosen event (n8n, Zapier, script…), signed with HMAC-SHA256 using the secret (X-Biblio-Signature header).
connectors.backups_help: A backup is made every day (the last 7 are kept): database, PDFs, notes, styles, settings. The full export is readable without Biblio: CSL-JSON, BibTeX, RIS, Markdown notes, PDFs.
connectors.restore_help: To restore: quit Biblio, then in a terminal run “biblio restore <archive>”. Current data is set aside, never erased.
